Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Liminal’s usage pattern for the last quarter aligns with the surge scenario we discussed; based on the numbers, the simplest way to keep latency and cost predictable is to lock in the expanded capacity tier for Q3 (additional 120k tokens/month committed).

Two quick billing items we need to close to align contracting and invoicing:
- New billing entity: you mentioned the acquisition and that invoices should be issued to Liminal Labs International Ltd (EU entity) for part of the expansion. Please confirm the exact legal name and VAT ID (we’ll need this on the invoice).
- PO & net terms: will your procurement team issue a PO referencing HubSpot deal HS-72543? Also confirm whether Net30 still applies or if you need Net45 for the new entity.

If procurement prefers, we can accept a single consolidated PO that lists both entities and split invoicing, or two POs (one for the US parent, one for the EU entity). Our finance team (cc’d Connor) will scope the onboarding checklist and required tax forms (W-9 / W-8 / VAT evidence).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You share the billing entity details + preliminary PO (or PO number).
2) Connor/finance confirm acceptance and whether any amendment to the MSA is required for Net45.
3) We send a one-page amendment for signatures and then start the Q3 capacity on the committed tier.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that’s faster.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear next steps. A couple of clarifications from procurement/finance side:

1) Billing entity: we will invoice against Liminal Labs International Ltd for the EU consumption (VAT ID: EU-GB123456789). The US parent (Liminal Labs, Inc.) will continue to receive the US invoice. We prefer separate invoices per legal entity.

2) Net terms: procurement asks if Redwood can extend Net45 for the EU entity for this renewal (temporary for the first two invoices), because our AP cycle for acquired businesses is month-end + 45.

3) PO: I’ll have procurement issue a PO referencing HS-72543 by EOD Tuesday. I’ve attached the placeholder PO number they will use (PO_98765.pdf) — final signed PO will follow once finance signs off.

4) Tax forms: since one entity is EU-based, they will send a W-8 / VAT residency certificate for the EU entity and a W-9 for the US parent where applicable.

Can your team confirm whether separate invoices with separate billing contacts are supported and if you need any particular fields on the PO (account number, billing contact, invoice remittance address)?

Appreciate it,
Ellen Park
Head of Procurement, Liminal Labs
ellen.park@liminallabs.com

Marissa / Connor —

Thanks for the context. Quick answers from AR/Finance:

- Net45: We can approve a temporary Net45 for the EU entity for the first two invoices tied to HS-72543, provided we have a signed amendment that references the PO number and the committed capacity uplift. This is a credit-risk mitigation step; terms revert to Net30 thereafter unless escalated.

- Separate invoices: Supported. We will create a separate AR customer record for Liminal Labs International Ltd (EU). We need the legal name, VAT ID, and a remit-to email for that entity.

- Required docs: For European entity: VAT certificate and signed amendment. For US parent: W-9 if not already on file. Please also ask procurement to include the HubSpot deal ID (HS-72543) on the PO and to reference the invoice remit-to email exactly.

- PO fields (recommended): PO number, billing legal name, billing address, remit-to email (invoices@liminallabs.com), requested payment terms (Net45 noted), and a line item referencing the committed capacity add-on (line: Redwood Inference - Q3 committed capacity - HS-72543).

I’ve attached our AR checklist and sample amendment template (AR_instructions.pdf). Once we have the signed PO + amendment + VAT/W-9, we can process and exchange invoices on the agreed cadence.

Action items:
1) Ellen/procurement: send final PO and VAT/W-9.
2) Marissa: send amendment template to Ellen for signature (I can attach finance-approved wording).
3) Connor: create EU AR account once docs are in; then we’ll confirm Net45 for first two invoices.

Ben Carter
